title: SGE feature spec frontmatter (L3)
description: The frontmatter of an SGE feature spec (SPEC-NNN, or legacy SGD-NNN / SGE-NNN). Two forms are accepted: a yaml code block that opens the file and holds a top-level spec: mapping (this schema validates that mapping), or YAML between --- lines at the top of the file (this schema validates the whole mapping). Every spec also carries acceptance criteria, per x-sge-sections. SPEC-133.

id.description: The spec id. It must match the id that starts the file name (x-sge-idMatchesFilename).

ref.description: Legacy alias of id, used by the --- form. It must match the file name too.

status.description: Lifecycle status: the vocabulary scripts/build-sge-dag.mjs maps to a delivery phase (pre-build, building, built, retired).

capability.description: The capability id (from the capability model) this spec belongs to.

feature.description: The feature id (from the capability model) this spec specifies.

success_measure_moved.description: The Vision success measure (SM-N) this spec moves.

tracking_issue.description: The issue that tracks the work.

gherkin_exempt.description: true for a spec that is not a behavioural contract, such as a decision protocol. It is exempt from the acceptance-criteria section.

x-sge-sections.name: acceptance criteria
x-sge-sections.description: A heading naming acceptance criteria, Gherkin or scenarios; or a Gherkin 'Scenario:' line; or an acceptance_criteria: key in the frontmatter block.
